verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Austin's 2nd Street District, with a front-row seat to the Austin City Limits music venue.

verified_facts.text: Scott Newton's photographs of Austin's music scene can be seen in each guest room.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have hardwood floors, a Marshall speaker and blue-green wall and ceiling paint that reflects Lady Bird Lake.

verified_facts.text: Some suites have a personal terrace overlooking the rooftop pool.
